Conclusion:
Accepted. ITU-R BT.2124-0 supplies the externally justified potential visibility boundary of 1 Delta E ITP. The independently realized ICC sRGB-to-ITP transforms agree within the declared experiment limit, and every reported in-gamut boundary search reaches that value within the declared residual. E3 must therefore compare mapped candidate and fine reference colours directly and require Delta E ITP plus its fine reference uncertainty plus the reported display-transform uncertainty to remain strictly below 1.
